mentions.name: Toregard
mentions.description: A new tab web app that shows a public domain artwork from a real museum each time you open a tab, serving as an antidote to doomscrolling. Users can create an account to save favourites, curate their own gallery, and make public collections. Art is sourced from The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Art Institute of Chicago, Rijksmuseum, and Cleveland Museum of Art.
mentions.problem: Built as an antidote to doomscrolling; the author wanted more art and colour in the workday—something to look at, learn through and draw inspiration from in the moments between meetings and code.
mentions.audience: Individuals wanting more art and colour in their workday, to look at and draw inspiration from between meetings and code
mentions.source_excerpt: A small thing I've been building as an antidote to doomscrolling. Open a new tab and see a public domain artwork from a real museum: https://toregard.art
